release_notes: The dashboard chart is rebuilt around real values: clicks, uniques, offer clicks and bots share one auto-scaled left axis (from 10 to millions) and money keeps the right axis, replacing the old 'percent of the first point' scale that made curves incomparable; conversions, leads, sales, ROI, rates and unit prices are drawn in their own scale with exact values and the change vs the previous hour/day in the tooltip. Every dashboard card can now be drawn on the chart (28 metrics instead of 11), hours that have not happened yet are no longer drawn as zeros, last 7/30 days no longer drop the oldest day the cards still count, and axis labels follow the panel language. The gear menu gains per-user line colours and line types (swatch palette, custom colour, a colour-blind-friendly preset, reset to theme) saved to the signed-in profile, with a metric card's glow matching its line. Also fixes a finance-masking leak: profit_confirmed and roi_confirmed were reaching users whose revenue is hidden.
